Experience working within a large, complex or highly regulated environment will be highly regarded.

This is more than just a DevOps role — it’s an opportunity to have genuine ownership and influence over how technology is delivered.

  • Work with modern cloud, automation and DevOps technologies.

Paxus is partnering with a major Federal Government organisation to engage one (1) Senior Data Analyst to support the design, analysis and delivery of trusted statistics and data-driven insights for operational and decision-making outcomes.

This is a great opportunity for a hands-on analyst who can work across data analysis, business/process analysis, stakeholder engagement, documentation and delivery support in a complex enterprise environment.

Contract details

  • Location: Canberra, ACT (hybrid)
  • Estimated start date: Monday, 2 November 2026
  • Initial contract: to 30 June 2027 with up to 2 x 12 months
  • Hours: up to 40 hours/week
  • Onsite expectation: Full-time onsite for the first month (or until up to speed), then minimum 2 days per week onsite in Canberra
  • Security: Baseline clearance must

What you’ll be doing

You will work with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, analyse data and systems, and support delivery of improvements. Key responsibilities include:

  • Analysing business processes, systems, data flows and operational needs to identify improvement opportunities
  • Eliciting, documenting and validating business, functional and non-functional requirements
  • Producing analysis artefacts such as process maps, workflow diagrams, use cases and user stories
  • Analysing data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, issues and opportunities
  • Supporting systems analysis and impact assessments for changes/enhancements
  • Creating and maintaining high-quality documentation (requirements, process models, reporting materials, etc.)
  • Supporting testing activities (test planning, UAT support, defect management)
  • Supporting data quality and data governance activities to improve consistency/integrity
  • Facilitating workshops and stakeholder sessions, building consensus and communicating insights clearly
  • Contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge transfer, with documentation stored per recordkeeping policies

Deliverables you may produce

Depending on project needs, deliverables can include:

  • Technical specifications and designs (including matrices)
  • System design specifications
  • Workflows, events and sequence diagrams
  • UML diagrams
  • Environment/context definitions
  • Unit test plans

Essential skills / experience (aligned to capability expectations)

  • Business intelligence reporting support using standard tools, including data preparation from existing sources
  • Business situation analysis in ambiguous/complex environments, including root cause analysis and actionable recommendations
  • Strong data communication skills: translating insights for technical and non-technical audiences, and confidently challenging/validating results
  • Ability to identify and structure research questions and define measures/approaches to answer them
  • Scripting/programming capability for simple programs (design, code, test, document, refactor) with good engineering and security practices
  • Ability to interpret and create basic visualisations (charts/graphs) and explain them clearly

Desirable experience

  • Requirements elicitation and workshop facilitation with cross-functional stakeholders (data/intelligence/risk/operations)
  • Data and systems analysis across processes, integrations and enterprise environments (process maps, use cases, impact assessments)
  • Supporting delivery and governance: requirements management, testing support, risk/issue identification, documentation, and working in multi-disciplinary teams

Application requirements (important)

job.title: Senior Management Accountant
job.description:
Senior Management Accountant

Location: Sunshine Coast, QLD | Full-time

Are you an experienced Management Accountant looking for an opportunity where your financial expertise can make a meaningful difference to a growing regional community?

We are seeking a Senior Management Accountant to join a high-performing finance team within a large and complex public-sector organisation. This is an opportunity to step into a strategic finance role where you’ll work closely with senior leaders, provide trusted financial advice, and help shape sound financial decision-making across a diverse organisation.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Management Accountant, you will play a key role in financial planning, budgeting, reporting and business analysis, partnering with stakeholders to support effective financial management and organisational performance.

Depending on your area of focus, the role may have responsibility across operating budgets, capital budgets, long-term financial modelling and costing analysis — or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work closely with management and finance leadership to provide meaningful insights, challenge assumptions and translate financial information into practical business decisions.

What you'll be doing

  • Coordinate and contribute to the annual budgeting and budget review process, including preparation of submissions for senior leadership.
  • Provide high-level financial advice on budget allocations, financial performance, job costing and long-term financial modelling.
  • Produce and analyse monthly financial performance reports, identifying trends, variances and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with business areas to understand their operations, financial requirements and performance drivers.
  • Provide accounting and business analysis support across directorates, branches and management teams.
  • Develop and maintain processes to monitor the financial performance of operational and capital projects.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of financial policies, procedures and processes.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and provide clear, commercially focused financial advice.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced finance professional who can combine strong technical accounting capability with commercial thinking, stakeholder management and business partnering skills.

You'll ideally bring:

  • A tertiary qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
  • At least 5 years' experience in a Management Accountant role within a large organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing financial reports in accordance with relevant accounting standards.
  • Strong capability in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and providing high-level financial advice.
  • Experience working with integrated financial systems, databases and advanced spreadsheet applications.
  • Highly developed communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to influence, consult and build strong working relationships.
  • A current C class driver's licence.

Membership of a relevant professional accounting association will be highly regarded.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is more than a traditional accounting role. You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Partner with senior leaders and influence important financial decisions.
  • Work across a large and complex organisation with diverse operational and capital portfolios.
  • Apply your expertise across budgeting, financial modelling, business analysis and strategic financial planning.
  • Contribute to projects and initiatives that have a real and visible impact on the community.
  • Join an organisation committed to professional development, wellbeing, diversity and inclusion.
  • Enjoy the lifestyle benefits of working on the beautiful Sunshine Coast while contributing to the future growth and sustainability of the region. The organisation's broader vision focuses on creating a connected, liveable and thriving region.

Ready for your next career move?

If you're a Senior Management Accountant who enjoys working beyond the numbers, partnering with stakeholders and using financial insight to influence better business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

Dynamics 365 CRM/CCM Lead (Contract)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Dynamics 365 CRM/CCM Lead to join a high-performing Commercial Systems team. Reporting to the Value Stream Manager, Commercial Systems, this role will act as the key liaison between business stakeholders and the external delivery partner, ensuring the successful operation, enhancement, and continuous improvement of the Dynamics 365 platform.

This is a business-facing, techno-functional role with a stronger emphasis on business capability, product ownership, stakeholder engagement, and vendor management rather than hands-on development. The successful candidate will oversee the Dynamics 365 Sales platform, drive roadmap and backlog prioritisation, and ensure solutions deliver strong business value.

Initially, the role will support the completion and transition of a major Dynamics 365 uplift project before moving into ongoing BAU ownership and continuous improvement activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary relationship manager between business stakeholders and the external delivery partner (Capgemini).
  • Own and manage the Dynamics 365 Sales platform from a business and functional perspective.
  • Drive product roadmap development, prioritisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog, user stories, sprint planning, and release activities.
  • Facilitate governance forums with business stakeholders and guide prioritisation decisions.
  • Review and challenge vendor-proposed solutions, estimates, and technical approaches.
  • Support transition of project deliverables into BAU operations, including validation of documentation and outstanding backlog items.
  • Oversee Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) processes.
  • Manage incidents, problems, changes, releases, and service requests through established ITSM processes.
  • Monitor vendor performance, SLA compliance, and service delivery outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
  • Coordinate weekly releases and support bi-annual major platform releases.
  • Identify opportunities to improve application performance, user experience, and business processes.
  • Support and enhance existing test automation capabilities where required.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, particularly the Sales module.
  • Strong techno-functional understanding of Dynamics 365 configuration, customisation, data structures, and business processes.
  • Experience working in a Product Owner, CRM Lead, Application Manager, Platform Lead, or similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing third-party vendors and delivery partners.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, sprint planning, and Agile delivery practices.
  • Knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management, release management, incident management, and problem management processes.
  • Experience with ServiceNow or comparable ITSM platforms.
  • Ability to work independently, solve problems, and operate effectively in an evolving environment.

Desirable

  • Experience with Power Platform, Dataverse, and SharePoint.
  • Exposure to test automation frameworks and automation pipelines.
  • Knowledge of governance, compliance, audit, and security requirements in enterprise environments.
  • Experience transitioning applications from project delivery into BAU support.

Personal Attributes

  • Commercially minded with a strong business focus.
  • Proactive and outcomes-driven.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete documentation.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to challenge requirements and vendor recommendations constructively.
  • Hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Contract Details

  • Contract Type: 6-month rolling contract
  • Team: Commercial Systems / BAU Technology
  • Industry: Enterprise Technology & Business Systems
  • Potential for Extension: Yes, based on ongoing platform expansion and business demand.

Keywords: Dynamics 365, Dynamics CRM, Dynamics 365 Sales, CRM Lead, Product Owner, Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint, ServiceNow, Vendor Management, Agile, Scrum, ALM, Release Management, Stakeholder Management, Continuous Improvement, Application Support.
